nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing UVLOCK Sun Cushion SPF 50

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and comfortable wear, with some specifically noting relief from redness and no breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin note the formula feels moisturizing and non-drying, though one warns it may emphasize dry patches during blending.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily-combination skin praises the texture and after-feel, with the main complaint being the small amount of product rather than oiliness.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the product as moisturizing and hydrating, leaving skin feeling moist rather than dry after application.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with sensitive or irritation-prone skin report the cushion soothes and cools irritated skin without causing redness; no dissent noted.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts say the product has not caused new ones, including one who notes many sunscreens usually break her out; no reports of caused breakouts appear in this set.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the finish as non-greasy and lightweight, with one specifically calling out a non-greasy feel despite expecting shine.

aspects.libelle: Sponge dries out or dispenses unevenly

extraits.texte: I picked this up because I was intrigued by the idea of a cushion sunscreen. I really like the formula of the sunscreen itself - it applies nicely, blends easily, and leaves my skin feeling moisturised. My only complaint is that it's hard to really tell how much product is in the cushion and how much will come out on the puff, so I worry that I'm not applying enough or applying it evenly. It would also be nice if we could buy refill cushions. I haven't had any irritation while using it, and a lot of sunscreens cause major breakouts for me.

I ordered this product based on someone's instagram that I follow. That also enjoy round lab products. The only draw back for them was they stated it leaves their skin a little too white. I am pale. So I don't notice it. My skin tone is very pink but this product is great when I'm outside a tone and don't have the tube! I have used it on my face, neck and tops of hands. I'm outside a majority of the time and I'm still not burnt! I have not had any break outs and it's not harsh on my skin. Definitely a products I'm going to keep in stock in my house.

extraits.texte: Secure packaging, the puff is nice and squishy and the sponge with the sun cream in distributes the product evenly. In terms of application, there is a white cast, but the sun cream itself goes on matte. It's good for re-applications in the summer, but may emphasise dry skin. Overall, the product goes on smoothly and doesn't feel drying on the skin.

extraits.titre: Absolutely amazing and hydrating sunscreen cushion!
extraits.texte: Absolutely amazing and hydrating sunscreen cushion! It has almost a non existent scent and works well with my sensitive skin. It has a very subtle whitecast but it goes away quickly.

extraits.titre: Love the texture and the after effect
extraits.texte: Love the texture and the after effect. It is great for oily combi skin. Only downside is I feel that the cushion has quite little product. Will repurchase again!
I have a very deep complexion & this does not leave a cast & definitely protects my incredibly sensitive skin!
I press on it and almost nothing comes out. I have to press a lot and the application takes FOREVER. I live in Texas and I still felt the tingle of the sun wearing this.
